name: amzy-ai
description: Quote and schedule junk-removal services through live Amzy coverage, pricing, availability, and booking workflows.

interface.longDescription: Amzy AI helps people arrange junk removal. It checks whether service is available for a ZIP code, provides a ZIP-specific pricing baseline and an item-aware quote, shows live pickup availability, and submits an unassigned pickup request only after the customer approves the final summary. The service does not process payments, hold appointment slots, assign contractors, or create an immutable dispatch.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check whether junk removal is available for my ZIP code, estimate the price for my items, and help me schedule a pickup.

positive.description: Check whether a junk-removal job is serviceable.
positive.prompt: Is junk removal available for a sofa and mattress in ZIP code 98003?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns serviceability, contractor coverage, and vehicle-size availability for the ZIP without holding a time slot.

positive.prompt: What is the current base pricing for junk removal in ZIP code 98003?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the configured ZIP-specific base rate or a clear unavailable response; it does not present the result as a complete quote.

positive.description: Build an incremental quote from validated job details.
positive.prompt: For my validated 98003 job, quote a sofa and mattress and help me choose a pickup time.
positive.expected_behavior: Continues the conversation and returns the next question or quote; it does not hold a slot or submit a booking.

positive.description: Review live pickup options during a conversation.
positive.prompt: Show me the available pickup times for this Amzy conversation on 2026-10-05.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns current vehicle-compatible appointment options for the stored conversation date without changing the booking.

positive.description: Submit a pickup request after explicit approval.
positive.prompt: I approve the final summary. Submit the pickup request.
positive.expected_behavior: After the server verifies the validated conversation and explicit approval, submits the unassigned request and reports the result without processing payment or assigning a contractor.

negative.prompt: Will it rain in Seattle tomorrow?

negative.description: Unsupported contractor directory or manual assignment request.
negative.prompt: List every contractor's phone number and assign this job to one of them.

review.commerce_description: Amzy AI does not process payments or authorize charges; it submits an unassigned pickup request after explicit approval.

publication.release_notes: Initial Amzy AI package with MCP-based service validation, pricing, quoting, availability, and booking workflows.
